limitations: This is a static fixture integration review; Docker execution and its release-bound outcome are separate evidence.

The planner request compiler receives current staged summaries after authored preflight admission. It does not demonstrate an actual router planner reading those summaries or generating goals from them.
Both selector arms receive the same compact hints. Historical-summary discovery cost and model choice quality remain unmeasured.
Unchanged-source claims bind only declared release files. Retained private receipts/prompts/session descriptors are not public artifacts.
Canonical request/response bytes, framed IPC bytes and CLI stdout bytes are separately reported. They describe distinct transfer layers and must not be added together as independent costs.

resolved_findings.resolution: Root setup now writes an explicit root-owned0444 fixture mode file. Worker reads this file and owner compares effective mode. Production environment scrub remains unchanged.
